description:
In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts, make exactly ONE edit.

Verbatim anchor (a single line):
              if (!landedSha) { opts.learningSink?.alphaBetaDelta.push(await penaliseHollowTemplate("feature_compose", "staged-favorable-not-landed")); }

Insert this single new line immediately AFTER that anchor line, verbatim:

              recordDeterministicLabel(goal ?? "", landedSha ? `feature_compose:${landedSha}` : undefined, "feature_compose", { reached: !!landedSha, reason: `deterministic:edit-intent-${landedSha ? `landed ${landedSha}` : "staged-not-landed"}`, deterministic: true });

Leave the anchor line unchanged. Change nothing else in the file. Keep the ternaries and every template interpolation exactly as written.

WHY: this is the ROUTED edit-intent completion path. Its sibling, the EARLY edit-intent path, received this exact call earlier today (commit 1db4415) and the routed path was left without one — so an edit that completes here still reaches the oracle corpus through no path at all. recordDeterministicLabel has only four call sites (roughly 4885, 10266, 12963, 16163); a pre-walk-routed edit goal executes none of them.

MEASURED MINUTES AGO: an edit dispatched through this path landed successfully in repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts and produced no goal_verification_labels row of any verdict. Adding the deterministic: prefix to this path's reason strings was already done (d08fe74) and is not sufficient by itself, because the call is missing.

All identifiers are already in scope at that point: goal, landedSha. The call mirrors the reconciliation path at 16163 and the early path at its own insertion point. It records BOTH polarities — a staged-not-landed outcome is labelled not_achieved as faithfully as a landing is labelled achieved — so this makes the corpus complete rather than merely more favourable. Grading is untouched: reached is still computed as !!landedSha.
